crossRefs.note: “Therefore tell them, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “None of my words will be deferred any more, but the word which I speak…
They will know that I am Yahweh. I have not said in vain that I would do this evil to them.” ’
Tell them, ‘As I live, says Yahweh, surely as you have spoken in my ears, so I will do to you.
Yahweh of Armies has sworn, saying, “Surely, as I have thought, so shall it happen; and as I have purposed, so shall it…
so is my word that goes out of my mouth: it will not return to me void, but it will accomplish that which I please, and…
Yahweh has done that which he planned. He has fulfilled his word that he commanded in the days of old. He has thrown…
He has confirmed his words, which he spoke against us, and against our judges who judged us, by bringing on us a great…
But my words and my decrees, which I commanded my servants the prophets, didn’t they overtake your fathers? “Then they…
Heaven and earth will pass away, but my words will not pass away.
It will turn out as a testimony for you.
Heaven and earth will pass away, but my words will by no means pass away.
For Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel says: “Behold, I will cause to cease out of this place, before your eyes and in…
“Look among the nations, watch, and wonder marvelously; for I am working a work in your days, which you will not…
Most certainly I say to you, this generation will not pass away until all these things happen.
Heaven and earth will pass away, but my words will not pass away.
Yahweh’s word also came to me, saying,
“Son of man, you dwell in the middle of the rebellious house, who have eyes to see, and don’t see, who have ears to…

translations.web: For I am Yahweh. I will speak, and the word that I speak will be performed. It will be no more deferred; for in your days, rebellious house, I will speak the word, and will perform it,” says the Lord Yahweh.’ ”
translations.bsb: because I, the LORD, will speak whatever word I speak, and it will be fulfilled without delay. For in your days, O rebellious house, I will speak a message and bring it to pass, declares the Lord GOD.’”
translations.kjv: For I am the LORD: I will speak, and the word that I shall speak shall come to pass; it shall be no more prolonged: for in your days, O rebellious house, will I say the word, and will perform it, saith the Lord GOD.
translations.asv: For I am Jehovah; I will speak, and the word that I shall speak shall be performed; it shall be no more deferred: for in your days, O rebellious house, will I speak the word, and will perform it, saith the Lord Jehovah.
